ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Questions refer to the following figure that illustrates the evolution of nine species from a single ancestral species. Roman numerals I through V identify different areas of the figure. Is stabilizing selection the factor that is responsible for the evolution pattern indicated by area III?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is labeled Phenotypic Divergence, and the vertical axis is labeled Time. Roman numeral III is located in the upper-middle right part of the figure, corresponding to an upward time range; in this area, multiple species lineages mainly appear as nearly vertical lines, with very little horizontal spread, indicating very little phenotypic divergence. Reasoning: The question asks whether the evolutionary pattern shown in region III is caused by stabilizing selection. A lineage pattern that is nearly vertical, maintains similar phenotypes over a long period, and lacks obvious horizontal divergence represents stasis or phenotypic stability. Stabilizing selection preserves intermediate or existing adaptive phenotypes and reduces deviation, thereby producing this pattern of very little phenotypic change. Therefore the answer is affirmative.

Is stabilizing selection the factor that is responsible for the evolution pattern indicated by area III?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: locate Roman numeral III and note that the lineages in that zone are nearly vertical rather than spreading laterally. Then read the question text as asking whether stabilizing selection is responsible for the pattern in area III. Bridge the visual pattern to biology: vertical lineage persistence with minimal phenotypic divergence represents stasis, which is the expected effect of stabilizing selection. Conclude that the answer is Yes.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中横轴标为 Phenotypic Divergence，纵轴标为 Time。罗马数字 III 位于图的右侧中上部，对应一段向上的时间范围；在这一带，多条物种谱系主要呈近乎垂直的线条，横向扩散很小，表示表型分化很少。推理：题目问 III 区域所示的进化模式是否由稳定化选择造成。近乎垂直、长期保持相似表型而缺少明显横向分化的谱系模式代表停滞或表型稳定。稳定化选择会保留中间或已有适应性表型、减少偏离，从而产生这种表型变化很小的模式。因此答案是肯定的。

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧纵轴表示 Time，底部横轴表示 Phenotypic Divergence。进化线从底部单一祖先开始，在较低区域发生分支；右侧罗马数字 V 和 IV 标出较低的分化/分支区间。区域 III 是右侧较大的上部时间区间，在这一段中，多个后代物种的谱系大多近似竖直向上延伸，水平位移很小，也没有明显的新分叉或持续向某一方向偏移。推理：题目询问区域 III 所示的进化模式是否由 stabilizing selection（稳定化选择）负责。稳定化选择的特点是维持已有表型、限制表型向两端或某一方向发生明显变化，因此会表现为谱系在表型轴上相对稳定、缺少方向性改变或新的分化。区域 III 中物种线主要是持续向上而非横向发散，这与稳定化选择相符。因此答案是 Yes。
